_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +78% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.53; conservative 2yr -23%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.4%/yr (worst year FY07-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.0%/yr (Q4 2017 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.9%/yr (FY07-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2018-01-26) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (61.3% downside to Bear $52 / +-2.4% upside to Bull $131) | Adj composite 2.06 vs market 3.59: gap -1.53 [OVERVALUED] | +78% above the EPP floor $75 (13x FY18E $5.79) | Conservative 2-yr case: -23.3% total (-11.6%/yr) | At 23.2x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $178 sits above the BULL case; carloads +1% in Q4 2017, forward revenue +5% (no FY18 revenue guide, Q4 2017 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
